ABOUT THIS FIELD

A catalogue
in the making.

This is an incomplete research catalogue, not an authenticated catalogue raisonné. The total inventory of Kelly’s paintings is not established here. Records with missing details are preserved; works absent from the sources may still be missing entirely.

How to read the field

“Earliest work per title” selects the earliest dated record in each recorded title group. Distinct works and later records remain available when this filter is off. A shared title does not establish that two records describe the same physical object.

Color and shape are discovery attributes. Check each record’s notes and source before treating them as authoritative. Recorded scale uses the recorded height and width, including multi-panel overall dimensions where supplied. In Gallery, choose Include estimated sizes or Estimated sizes only to include unresolved works using approximate dimensions. Estimates preserve the SVG proportions; open a work for its confidence, source anchors and comparable works. Catalogue measurements remain unchanged. Estimation methods ↗ · Estimate data ↓.

Missing images have explicit placeholders. SVG studies are interpretive reconstructions; geometry and screen colour approximate. Vivid preview adjusts their screen colour and is not calibrated. Source photographs may retain their backgrounds; only assets identified as transparent PNGs are counted as cutouts. Images and underlying artworks retain their respective rights.
